question: Pandrethan temple of Srinagar is associated with which of the following religions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hinduism **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandrethan Temple:**

 
 
• The **Pandrethan Temple**, located in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu.
 
• It was built during the 10th century under the rule of the **Utpala dynasty**, a period known for its rich cultural and architectural heritage.
 
• The temple is constructed in the **Kashmiri style of architecture**, featuring intricate stone carvings and a pyramidal roof.
 
• It is one of the few surviving examples of Kashmiri Hindu architecture from the medieval period.
